cands.name: Walter Price
cands.bio: Republican; captain with Pasco County Fire Rescue (10+ years) and Pasco resident for nearly 20 years; lives in Land O' Lakes with his wife and three children.
cands.local_ties: Land O' Lakes, Pasco County; Pasco resident for nearly two decades (Florida Politics).

record.text: First candidate to file for the open HD 55 seat; his platform centers on cost of living, property insurance, law enforcement, parental rights and school choice.

endorsements.text: Sen. Ed Hooper, Pasco Sheriff Chris Nocco, CFO Blaise Ingoglia, Reps. Jeff Holcomb, Randy Maggard and Brad Yeager.
